summary_en: Minimum tender threshold lowered from 19,226,700 shares (64.93% S/O, 66.67% post-acquisition) to 15,988,500 shares (53.99% S/O, 55.73% post-acquisition). Tender price ¥1,580/share. Tender period extended to 2026-08-03 (55 business days). Purpose: complete subsidiary status.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to Notice Regarding Expression of Opinion Concerning Tender Offer by Kaga Electronics Co., Ltd. for Shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-17, Shinko Shoji announced a material amendment to its statement on the tender offer by Kaga Electronics Co., Ltd. to acquire Shinko Shoji shares. The minimum tender threshold has been reduced from 19,226,700 shares (64.93% of shares outstanding excluding treasury; 66.67% post-acquisition ownership) to 15,988,500 shares (53.99% of shares outstanding excluding treasury; 55.73% post-acquisition ownership). The tender price remains ¥1,580 per share. The tender period has been extended from the prior end date of 2026-07-29 to 2026-08-03, comprising 55 business days in total (originally 52 business days). The stated purpose remains completion of Shinko Shoji as a wholly owned subsidiary of Kaga Electronics. As documented in the filing, Shinko Shoji's shares outstanding (excluding treasury) total 29,612,599 shares as of 2026-03-31, and Kaga Electronics already holds 515,000 shares. The reduction in minimum threshold provides shareholders with additional time to evaluate participation in the tender offer.
